*Kirana Kart call notes* (Sep 18, Neha + their ops lead)
• They run ops on ~45 WhatsApp groups (you win the bet <@U02ANANYA>) + Slack for the tech team
• Biggest pain: dark-store managers promise restock times on WhatsApp and nobody tracks them
• They want WhatsApp first, Slack second. Gmail barely matters to them
• Data: Neha said Kirana Kart will share sample data by Friday next week, anonymised
• Pricing: didn't flinch at $49, but asked about per-store pricing instead of per-user
• Security: they need to know who sees what. Explained the RLS model, landed well
• Next step from their side: they want a pilot proposal
Overall: warmest of the three :fire:
Per-store pricing is interesting for them, but it breaks our seat model. Parking it.
